stem: A startup wants lower backup storage cost but still needs rapid operational recovery and long-term retention for quarterly audits. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use only cache-node snapshots as the legal data-retention record.
Keep automated backups for day-to-day operational restore windows.
Replace all backups with read replicas and remove retention policies.
Keep fewer long-term copies by deleting old manual snapshots per policy.
Set every environment to the maximum retention window by default.

rationale: Automated backups support operational recovery windows, while manual snapshot lifecycle policy controls long-term storage growth. Cache snapshots do not replace authoritative relational backup controls. Read replicas are not backup-policy substitutes. Maximum retention everywhere increases cost without workload-class justification.
